newsitem.title: USA: Pinkerton's agrees to buy security business.
newsitem.headline: Pinkerton's agrees to buy security business.

text.p: Pinkerton's Inc said it has agreed to acquire all of the assets of Sensormatic Electronic Corp Enterprise Accounts Division-U.S., which is a part of Sensormatic's Commercial/Industrial Worldwide Operations.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. The companies said that the transaction is expected to be completed in June.

Sensormatic's EAD unit is a provider of security systems integration services to commercial and industrial clients throughout the United States. EAD employs about 425 people and had 1996 revenues of almost $80 million.
